phases.title: Fix vitest.config.ts: correct include pattern, enable globals, fix setupFiles path
phases.notes: Changed globals to true, setupFiles from ./src/tests/setup.ts to ./tests/setup.ts, include from src/**/*.spec.ts to src/**/*.test.ts. All 19 tests now pass.

phases.title: Fix tsconfig.json: resolve TS5095 invalid option combination
phases.notes: Changed moduleResolution from 'node' (deprecated node10 in TS6, causing TS5107) to 'bundler', matching the '/* Bundler mode */' comment. Build now completes cleanly and all 19 tests still pass.

phases.title: Fix src/server.ts: add numeric fallback of 3001 when PORT env var is absent
phases.notes: Changed `Number(process.env.PORT)` to `Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001`. All 19 tests pass and build completes cleanly.

phases.title: Verify: run pnpm test and pnpm build to confirm all fixes pass
phases.notes: All 19 tests pass (vitest run) and build completes cleanly (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) with no errors.
